from glom import (
    Auto, Fill, Call, Invoke, Spec, Check, Path, Literal, 
    Coalesce, Inspect, Sum, Fold, Flatten, Merge, Iter, Assign
)
from glom.streaming import First

# Test all public specifier types have reprs
specs = [
    ('Auto()', Auto()),
    ('Fill()', Fill()),
    ('Call(print)', Call(print)),
    ('Invoke(getattr)', Invoke(getattr)),
    ('Spec()', Spec()),
    ('Check()', Check()),
    ('Check(type=int)', Check(type=int)),
    ('Path([\"a\", \"b\"])', Path(['a', 'b'])),
    ('Literal(1)', Literal(1)),
    ('Coalesce(1, 2)', Coalesce(1, 2)),
    ('Inspect()', Inspect()),
    ('Sum()', Sum()),
    ('Fold()', Fold()),
    ('Flatten()', Flatten()),
    ('Merge()', Merge()),
    ('Iter()', Iter()),
    ('First()', First()),
]

for name, spec in specs:
    try:
        rpr = repr(spec)
        print(f'{name}: {rpr}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{name}: ERROR - {e}')
"
